Clay.description: Heavy textured soil with high moisture and nutrient retention capacity, prone to waterlogging.

Loamy.description: Balanced soil texture offering ideal aeration, moisture retention, and fertility for most crops.

Sandy.description: Light, coarse soil with rapid percolation; requires frequent light irrigation and split fertilizer doses.

fym.name: Farm Yard Manure (FYM)
fym.benefits: Improves soil humus, CEC, microbial diversity, and water retention capacity.

vermicompost.name: Vermicompost
vermicompost.benefits: Rich in bioavailable micronutrients, plant growth hormones (auxins/gibberellins), and beneficial microbes.

neem_cake.name: Neem Cake
neem_cake.benefits: Natural nitrification inhibitor; reduces nitrogen leaching while suppressing soil-borne nematodes and root pests.

biofertilizers.pulses: Rhizobium leguminosarum (200 g/10 kg seed) + Phosphate Solubilizing Bacteria (PSB 2 kg/ha) for symbiotic nitrogen fixation.
biofertilizers.cereals: Azotobacter / Azospirillum (2 kg/ha) + PSB (2 kg/ha) incorporated with organic manure to boost natural nutrient cycling.
